claims.text: dispatch checks tool existence and registry map identity, validates input schema with envelope fallback for unsupported_keyword and openfresnel references, and returns untrusted payloads.
_execution_error maps recognized ToolError and LineageError codes in ERROR_CODES to execution failures and everything else to internal.
preview rehearses mutation tools through _operable_handler, _prepare_transaction validator runs and _PreviewEffect refusal of unprepared side effects.

decision.rule: Change here when tool dispatch validation, error mapping or dry-run preview needs to change.
decision.failure: Invalid inputs reach handlers, domain errors are misreported, or a dry-run preview commits side effects.

questions.q: Where does dispatch validate tool inputs before invoking handlers?
Where should I change the error-code mapping and dry-run preview rehearsal?
Where can I debug why a dispatched tool returns internal instead of its domain code?
